result:
The proposed answer of 20480 is incorrect, because the solution undercounts the choices of z-level.

**Setup.** The (x,y) projection of the path is a monotone lattice path from (0,0) to (3,3), and there are 20 of these. At each of the 7 points V₀,…,V₆ along it, Kelvin may make a run of z-moves. A run must be monotone (all up or all down), since otherwise a z-value would repeat at that (x,y). The z-level after the run at each of V₀,…,V₅ can be any value in {0,1,2,3}, and the last run at V₆ just climbs to 3.

**The error.** The solution fixes s₀ = 0 and counts only s₁,…,s₅, which gives 4⁵ = 1024. But at V₀ Kelvin starts at z = 0 and can move up before taking his first X or Y step. So s₀ can be 0, 1, 2 or 3, and the free levels are s₀,…,s₅, which is 6 values.

**Correct count.** Each of the 20 xy-paths has 4⁶ = 4096 valid z-profiles, so the total is 20 · 4096 = 81920. This differs from 20480.

VERDICT: REJECT
